name: Mission Work
overview: Mission work is a divine mandate rooted in Christ's command to proclaim the gospel universally. Believers are sent into the world to declare God's glory among all peoples and to make disciples by teaching and baptizing in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. This mission is both a witness to all nations and a fulfillment of Jesus' sending, continuing His work of redemption until the gospel reaches every creature. The ultimate purpose of mission work is to prepare the world for Christ's return, as the gospel must be preached to all before the end comes.
